name: Caspian
source: Caspian was never the favoured son, always too pompous and lazy to be seen as an asset in everyone's eyes. However, after his father and older brother fell in battles against the King, it fell down to him to lead the pirates. And he did it with the ruthless efficiency never seen before.
translation: Caspian was never the favoured son, always too pompous and lazy to be seen as an asset in everyone's eyes. However, after his father and older brother fell in battles against the King, it fell down to him to lead the pirates. And he did it with the ruthless efficiency never seen before.
